stem: The title of her final and unfinished film, Escape, was ____: indeed while shooting it, she was preoccupied with thoughts of desertion.
Except for a few passages in the biography in which the subject’s flaws are (i)____, the author’s treatment of her subject is (ii)____.

In a view of 17 studies from 2008, Trudeau and Shephard concluded that reserving up to an hour a day for (i)____ in school curricula does not (ii)____ academic achievement. In fact, they noted that more exercise often (iii)____ school performance, despite the time it took away from reading, writing, and arithmetic.
An abundance of nutrient-rich pollution in estuaries causes algae to ____, much as houseplants grow better when their soil contains added fertilizer.
Taking to the mountains to escape the chaos occasioned by the collapse of the ruling dynasty, artists looked to nature for ____ and a serenity not evident in human society.
The Great Lakes wolf is a ____, stumping scientists as to whether it is a subspecies of the gray wolf or a distinct species.
The book aims to illuminate how science has changed the meaning of nothingness from ____ philosophical concept to something we can almost put under a microscope.
